editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when the world's most chaotic little yellow guys try to be organized? You get this hilarious short where Margo, Agnes, and Edith come home from scout camp with cool badges, and three Minions decide they need them too. The vibe is pure chaos from start to finish. You will see these three try to follow the rules of scouting, but since they are Minions, everything goes wrong in the funniest way possible. It is a quick, bright, and loud ride that captures exactly why we love these characters.

What really works here is the physical comedy. You will laugh at the way they accidentally attract a bear and eat the wrong berries. The pacing is super fast, so you never get bored, though it is very short. If you have kids or just need a five-minute break from a stressful day, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After causing a total disaster that involves blowing up a dam and starting a massive flood, the Minions finally make it back home. Even though they failed every single task and caused a catastrophe, the girls are kind and share their own badges with them. This act of friendship inspires the rest of the Minion crew to start their own scouting adventures, ending the story on a sweet and funny note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves the Minions and quick laughs.
